+def fake_stream(segments: list[str], cap: int, lag: int):
+    """`mlx_lm.stream_generate` for a model that wants to generate `segments`,
+    one token each, then stop.
+
+    Like the real one: a response per token, then a last response that has
+    the finish reason and any text not sent yet. At the cap it stops with
+    "length"; otherwise the end-of-sequence token counts as generated. With
+    `lag`, the text of the newest `lag` tokens is held back, as a streaming
+    detokenizer does with an unfinished word.
+    """
+    held: list[str] = []
+    for token, segment in enumerate(segments):
+        held.append(segment)
+        if token + 1 == cap:
+            break
+        ready = len(held) - lag
+        text = "".join(held[:ready]) if ready > 0 else ""
+        del held[: max(ready, 0)]
+        yield SimpleNamespace(
+            text=text,
+            token=token,
+            prompt_tokens=3,
+            generation_tokens=token + 1,
+            finish_reason=None,
+        )
+    at_cap = len(segments) >= cap
+    yield SimpleNamespace(
+        text="".join(held),
+        token=None,
+        prompt_tokens=3,
+        generation_tokens=cap if at_cap else len(segments) + 1,
+        finish_reason="length" if at_cap else "stop",
+    )

551	class _ThinkingTracker:
552	    """Tells, segment by segment, whether a stream is inside a thinking block.
553	
554	    Looks only at each new segment plus a few carried characters (a tag can
555	    be split across segments), so the work per token does not grow with the
556	    length of the reply.
557	    """
558	
559	    def __init__(self, inside: bool = False) -> None:
560	        self._closing_tag = "</think>" if inside else None
561	        self._carry = ""
562	
563	    def feed(self, segment: str) -> bool:
564	        """Add a segment; True if any of it belongs to a thinking block."""
565	        text = self._carry + segment
566	        thinking = self._closing_tag is not None
567	        pos = 0
568	        while True:
569	            if self._closing_tag is None:
570	                found = [
571	                    (at, tag)
572	                    for tag in _THINKING_TAGS
573	                    if (at := text.find(tag, pos)) != -1
574	                ]
575	                if not found:
576	                    break
577	                at, tag = min(found)
578	                self._closing_tag = _THINKING_TAGS[tag]
579	                pos = at + len(tag)
580	                thinking = True
581	            else:
582	                at = text.find(self._closing_tag, pos)
583	                if at == -1:
584	                    break
585	                pos = at + len(self._closing_tag)
586	                self._closing_tag = None
587	        # Keep only what could still be the start of a tag.
588	        self._carry = text[pos:][-(_LONGEST_THINKING_TAG - 1) :]
589	        return thinking
